entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing multi-level states across users, sessions, and agents. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud, an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, or an OSS SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent data as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier L0/L1/L2 loading system to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains compared to standard baselines.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform enables persistent long-term memory by building self-hosted knowledge graphs from text, code, and session data. Compatible with Python 3.10–3.14, it facilitates session distillation and retrieval across various LLM providers.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain functions as an opinionated agent brain that builds knowledge graphs with typed edges to define entity relationships. It emphasizes provenance by supporting memory withdrawal and corrections while generating synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, this engine features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It includes connectors for platforms like Google Drive and GitHub, utilizing byte-level deduplication to provide a 100% prompt-cache discount.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides a learning-oriented memory system centered on retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It integrates with over 25 LLM providers and multiple database backends, offering SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library serves as the upstream foundation for stateful agents, extracting conclusions from conversation history to provide reasoning-first memory. It is implemented as a FastAPI server and supports managed hosting, local CLI execution, or Docker-based self-hosting.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Operating under the Elastic License 2.0, this official provider treats memory as a git repository with versioning features like commit, branch, and merge. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system—four of which are non-LLM—to achieve sub-100ms response times via an interactive TUI.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency, sub-millisecond memory system that relies on a single SQLite database and one pure-Python dependency. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and includes features for temporal recall, importance weighting, and episodic compression.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context. It runs on local infrastructure including Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive harness that stores immutable context bundles and outcome-gated promotion data in the filesystem. It helps agents succeed on complex tasks by executing iterative cycles to retain useful lessons and artifacts.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agent using a hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) and SQLite store. It ensures no messages are lost and includes specialized tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for precise detail recovery.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local session history from 25 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over months of past data. It processes up to 5 GB of history while automatically redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider for persistent state management.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signetai maintains a living semantic ontology through a background dreaming process to provide portable state across multiple agent clients. It achieves 97.6% average LongMemEval answer accuracy and supports real-time ingestion from GitHub, Discord, and Obsidian.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur utilizes an open engram YAML format to store memories as plain-text files for local ownership and multi-agent support. It employs a hybrid search strategy combining BM25 and embeddings for local-first retrieval across MCP-compatible tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and agent hooks, utilizing a hybrid retrieval system that includes both BM25 and vector search.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embedding models. The five-package family includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and supports Linux, macOS, and Windows environments.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization layer reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every result and includes a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps. It supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments and tracks contradictions and recency ranking.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable context as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It functions without telemetry or external databases, relying on local embedding models and hybrid BM25/semantic search.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for every agent query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server that uses GGUF models to provide RAG and vector search capabilities.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in 94% fewer prompt tokens. It provides local-first memory persistence and session history tracking through MCP-native stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This project provides reflective memory for agents through automated indexing of codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support. It utilizes semantic search via BM25 and ranked graph traversal, using edge tags to establish navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed for Hermes Agent v0.14.0, this tool reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking for tool selection. It includes a dashboard to track estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer manages context and workflows for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using hash-checked proposals and receipts. It facilitates reviewed context updates and offers a source-neutral migration path for chat and document exports.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a built-in 1-10 importance ranking system. It combines BM25 keyword search with importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority entries during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Addressing community issue #6715, this episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and supports immediate, permanent event deletion. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log to provide a transparent record of every memory and prefetch operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across 37 chains, including EVM and Solana. It settles payments directly to wallets with 0% fees and verifies transactions locally against the user's own RPC.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes and routes queries to local skills, scripts, and MCP servers. It provides tools for knowledge search and neighbor traversal, automatically generating tool routing notes through model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider ensures durable cross-session memory by implementing pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It features a local SQLite reliability layer with a write outbox to manage searching, remembering, and state updates.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin facilitates self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. it adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for search, file reads, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both native Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes. It utilizes HNSW ANN, sparse retrieval, and MinHash deduplication to manage long-term storage.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This project offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing triggered during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop that identifies data rot and contradictions within agent memory using a git-backed directory for versioned markdown storage. It utilizes five slash commands for capture and recall while generating evidence-cited JSON diffs for manual review and memory hygiene.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process to enable autonomous task execution. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that generates web, mobile, and desktop prototypes with sandboxed iframe previews. It supports 26 local CLI executables, including Hermes, and exports projects to formats such as HTML, PDF, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST CSF 2.0. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to enhance security-specific capabilities.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool generates editable .drawio files from natural language prompts, Mermaid text, or infrastructure configurations like Terraform and Kubernetes. It also enforces architecture rules and renders visual diffs within CI/CD pipelines.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments. It includes a verification and dispute resolution layer alongside vendored protocol skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It supports rewrite and detect-only modes and is compatible with agentskills.io, Claude Code, and OpenClaw.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a collective, evolving library compatible with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting skills and session traces to facilitate collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 14 metaskills that maintain state within a project's documentation folder. These spec-conformant plugins are designed for Claude Code, Codex, and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life skills distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. The skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code with ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent and other platforms to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and supports tools like OpenClaw, Cursor, and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects and proposes reusable skills by watching active workflows. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, providing slash commands to manage detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts by generating custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It includes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries via Git and S3 sources using Pydantic AI. It includes tools for reading bundled resources and executing untrusted scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate them from the host.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set converts rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. It features Lite and Full modes for varying project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill enables agents to generate .lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable files from documentation and automatically syncs source edits back to the original literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Designed for long-running agents, this harness implements the SLP cooperative-agent protocol for supervised teams using local-first SQLite and Git storage. It facilitates prompt-first working methods through Markdown-based recipes and structured memory.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides Hermes Agent skills in the SKILL.md format specifically for Portuguese-speaking users. It includes installation and configuration guides while maintaining compatibility with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables agent interaction with Oracle networks including CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams. These skills are installable via the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI for blockchain-related tasks.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video models via the BFL API, supporting polling, webhooks, and error handling. The package includes a router to direct specific requests to specialized video generation agents.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates agentskills.io-compliant skills from code, documentation, and developer discourse by linking instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits. It provides lifecycle tooling for version-pinned skill management and export.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, accessible via a Python client or CLI. It supports recursive dependency resolution during installation and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika defines AI workflows using a readable .nika.yaml file format for local-first execution with OpenAI or Codex access. It features a check command to audit task dependencies and estimate costs within a single Rust binary.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of decisions and progress. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and enables incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project fully implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project implements a five-layer retrieval system that uses hard triggers, FTS5, and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token usage and features graceful degradation if embedding models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution system uses MCP connections to allow Hermes Agent to drive scheduling, habit tracking, and study blocks. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces via a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial, edge-case, and integration analysis on codebases. It combines deterministic scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across various interfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a multi-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It employs a risk-tiered application process that requires an approval gate before applying changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project introduces systematic investigation protocols and evidence-based verification gates to Hermes Agent workflows. It utilizes a Python goal engine for persistent state management and implements multi-story task decomposition to prevent early-stop errors.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading through Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports automatic registration of skill directories and utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure of capabilities.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity environment provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics, network analysis, and exploitation. It integrates 28 industry frameworks and standards, covering real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery to agent workflows, providing memory between separate conversations. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes utilities for detecting state drift and scaffolding new skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible README demonstration GIFs using vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from rendering to compression, ensuring files remain under 8 MB for optimal embedding.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: A local-first observability dashboard that provides real-time monitoring across 11 tabs, including token costs and error tracking. It maintains a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports incident alerts via Telegram or Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and is compatible with clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language while preventing specification drift through weekly monitoring. It includes a CI-friendly validator that checks skills against runtime-specific profiles to ensure long-term compatibility.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose skill coverage gaps. It uses a local evaluation framework—including LLM-judge and regression tests—to gate updates without requiring external services.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: Designed for cross-environment compatibility, this skill handles deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, WSL, and Git Bash. It ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax without requiring new software installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols like x402 and MPP. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard, allowing Hermes Agents to handle paid web requests seamlessly.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, security, and functionality within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates to prove a skill works as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for creating bounty boards and buying context, with payments settled upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms via an MCP server featuring 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This news briefing generator creates structured reports ranging from global to street-level geographic scales. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and applies quality gates to its AI-driven analysis.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for Chinese-language tasks, including Douyin video transcription and document OCR on macOS. It also features a rule-based engine designed to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns from generated text.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It supports both open-source and proprietary software binaries, offering a reliable way to manage development tool dependencies.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone provides an automated installer and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a single-command Termux installer that sets up Hermes Agent on Android with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local Ollama models. It includes a gateway service and an interactive command-line interface for mobile operation.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on mobile environments.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating agents on Docker and Kubernetes, featuring a 69-entry credential catalog and 17+ LLM provider integrations. It secures agent operations using AES-256-GCM encryption and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows users to build specific Hermes tags and ensures persistent state through mounted home directories.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment uses systemd to run Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It is designed for headless operation and enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework simulates real-world trading firm dynamics using specialized LLM agents. It supports multiple providers, including Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, and features automated risk management evaluation with decision-log memory.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration system for governing agent registration, task dispatch, and cost tracking. It provides multiple interfaces, including a Web UI, CLI, REST API, and MCP server, with deployment options via Docker or Node.js.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, such as Claude Code and Hermes Agent. It utilizes tmux for persistent background sessions and includes container-based isolation and Git worktree management.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A control room template that serves as the first MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and detects HTTP signals to manage paid API states.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agents from single VPS instances to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenAI. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for managing team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board and live streams of reasoning. It implements human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across infrastructure, quality, implementation, planning, and research. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for task lifecycle management. It integrates ACP and MCP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring Kanban flows and agent dialogues.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TerminalBench-2 and TBLite evaluations while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena that orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It utilizes Hermes Agent and Paperclip for execution, with a real-time dashboard for tracking code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: A fully-local framework that implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes and Ollama on consumer GPUs. It utilizes parallel model querying and synthesis for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered knowledge graph that indexes code symbols and callers to minimize token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It automatically updates the index upon file changes and includes a browser-based UI for visualizing code relationships.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents and provides a Terminal User Interface for data visualization. Users can create profiles and submit their usage statistics to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from various coding agents while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the analysis of agent communication.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and rate limits across more than 35 AI coding tools. It synchronizes data across multiple devices and offers detailed usage breakdowns by model, session, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with various agents and providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 skills for application development. It supports autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project enables customization of the terminal UI through YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art to personalize their CLI experience.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A native port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel that operates without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for RL training and inference using vLLM and GGUF.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It enables agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP, supporting providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama. It features a supervisor sidebar for workflow management and an undo function for recent agent actions.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks and chat platforms using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports environments including LangGraph, CrewAI, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations, local memories, and specific skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining project-local custom instructions and tools.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for a hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with support for 29 community plugins across six functional categories at zero cost.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that performs deterministic analysis of agent configurations and system prompts without requiring LLM or API calls. It identifies ambiguous tool descriptions and conflicting directives, supporting CI integration through SARIF output and baseline management.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transfers OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles the mapping of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems via a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry. It features two-mode monitoring—passive analysis and active probing—to detect performance drift relative to local file changes without cloud dependencies.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project offers a deterministic, zero-network local runtime designed to help users generate revenue using Hermes Agent. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for external actions and exposes its functionality through dynamic slash commands.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, wake-word-activated interaction to Hermes Agent across 35 languages. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities using Piper and Kokoro without requiring accounts or API keys.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This plugin integrates MemOS memory storage with Hermes, supporting semantic search and multi-dimensional storage. It includes dedicated tools for managing memories and a circuit breaker to handle potential MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux users. It centralizes configuration management for Hermes Agent alongside other tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write capabilities. It supports remote access via WebUI and messaging platforms, offering 21 professional assistants for specialized tasks like document and presentation creation.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web interface enables mobile and browser-based access to Hermes Agent without a build step. It includes a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure connectivity through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This companion application simplifies the lifecycle of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in a single desktop environment.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This dashboard offers a visual workflow builder with human approval gates and scheduled jobs for Hermes and other agent runtimes. It features unified configuration for 10 platforms, including WhatsApp and WeChat, alongside usage analytics and channel management.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a full file browser with Monaco, a PTY terminal, and dedicated panels for memory browsing and MCP catalog management.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents, including Hermes, into desktop, mobile, or self-hosted environments. It allows for the registration of any ACP-compatible agent to expand its multi-agent coding capabilities.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for system repair. It includes native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application features a built-in kernel for health checks and updates. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering while providing native window and process management for chat and memory tasks.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects browser context to local or remote runtimes, featuring intelligent tab scoping and group chat capabilities. It includes Hermes Assist, which provides site-aware drafting across 31 different writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that allows users to drive self-hosted Hermes agents through real-time streaming chat with file attachments. It enables mobile management of server files, agent skills, and scheduled cron jobs without using web wrappers.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with integrated custom LLM model routing. It features a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth, git projects, and cron jobs. It includes a tmux operator view designed specifically for managing live agent panes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks live Codex and Claude quota burn and estimated API costs for Hermes agents. It builds local search indexes to query prompts, tool calls, and command outputs without uploading session history or telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and supports the administration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop environment runs via local Python and Node.js without requiring system dependencies, admin rights, or Docker. It includes 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI, supporting models via LM Studio and OpenRouter.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and an integrated file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside a task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring, offering real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace features a chat-first interface with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, as well as isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
